narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I can see the minus sign up there. Ten to the power minus three is minus one thousand.
<bookmark mark='small'/>Dividing one by ten gives a small part of one. It never drops below zero.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The minus sign in the exponent tells us to divide, not to make the number negative.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>A negative exponent means one over the same power with a positive exponent.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Write five to the power minus two as a fraction. Then check two to the power four times two to the power minus two.
